evidence.message: The first viewport now has one filled action: the exact npx install command. Header, GitHub, architecture, benchmark, and the long orchestration prompt are visibly subordinate.

The hero expresses the product method as Choose, Compile, Build, Prove before secondary product sections; approved choices and exact evidence are described as repository-bound artifacts rather than ambient AI judgment.
Clipboard failure selects the command or prompt for manual copy and reports the fallback through an aria-live message; keyboard focus treatments remain visible.
The hero no longer animates content into readability. The lower motion demo uses useReducedMotion to disable entrance, hover, press, pointer, pulse, and confetti effects when reduction is requested.

The deterministic scanner reports no hard errors and no SS004 reduced-motion warning. Its remaining 24 advisory findings are isolated demo or section color literals plus two arbitrary-width utilities, not blockers for the selected action or reading order.
